Done. Summary:

- Wrote `out/T3/solution.py`, a plain torch+safetensors script (run via `out/T3/run.sh`) that loads `inputs/base/model.safetensors`, casts exactly the 48 named projection matrices to bf16, drops the 12 `h.<i>.attn.bias` mask buffers via an anchored regex (careful not to also match the legitimate `h.<i>.attn.c_attn.bias` parameter), leaves everything else untouched float32, runs the four required checks before writing, then packs tensors into shards ≤64 MiB (oversized `wte.weight` alone in its own shard) and writes `model.safetensors.index.json`.
- Ran once — succeeded on the first attempt.
- Independently re-verified from disk afterward: 148 total tensors, 48 bf16 (bit-exact match to `tensor.to(torch.bfloat16)`), `wte.weight` float32 and bit-identical to input, all mask buffers absent, all parameter biases retained, shard byte budgets respected, index `weight_map` consistent with actual shard contents.
- Wrote `out/T3/REPORT.md` with the self-report, including the `attn.bias`/`c_attn.bias` naming pitfall and why I chose plain torch/safetensors over mergekit/peft for this task.
